name: Primeval Genesis
detailed_description:
Primeval Genesis is a third-person, hobbyist-built, narrative-driven survival shooter set on a remote island where prehistoric life has been brought back through experimental science. You play as Cole, a quiet and reserved prior service member hired on a contracted assignment by a shadowy corporation to provide security and ranger services.

What begins to appear as a quiet vacation of a job quickly spirals into chaos as strange events unfold on the secluded island and unseen threats begin to emerge.

Survive against deadly dinosaurs, hostile creatures, conspiratorial human factions, and the island’s stark contrast of dense jungle and industrial decay. Piece together the clues scattered across brutalist research labs, chemical storage sites, and crumbling power stations—assisted by your training officer and sarcastic, battle-hardened brit, Vinny.

This handcrafted single-player experience, created by a small team in Unreal Engine 4, seeks to blend environmental storytelling, cinematic gameplay, tension, and grounded science fiction to deliver a gripping and atmospheric story with an unsettling but wonderous backdrop.

Gameplay Features

🧠 Functional Enemies
Enemies are built to think, hunt, and attack. Raptors ambush in large tactical teams, Rexes overpower with brute force and chase relentlessly, Pteranodons strike from above, and human adversaries aim for the chinks in the armor. Watch as Raptors take down a roaming Stegosaurus from a safe distance, bait a rex into a crowd of hostiles and watch the action unfold chaotically as Cole.

🧩 Environmental Puzzles
Survive hastily built, crumbling industrial infrastructure and lush ecosystems by navigating outdated machinery, rerouting power, and bypassing hazardous zones filled with many a danger.

🚙 Vehicles
Ride alongside NPC controlled partners—or take the wheel yourself—as you speed through many semi-open levels as well as linear levels across wide plains, dense jungles, and collapsing sectors of industrial decay.

🎒 Inventory and Items
Use tools in real-time to turn the tide: auto-injectors for healing, flares to distract massive predators, or sound traps to sneak past patrols undetected.

📓 Environmental Storytelling
Uncover the fate of the facility’s staff through scattered journal entries, destroyed rooms, and haunting audio logs left behind in their final hours.

🎬 Cinematic-Focused Gameplay
Story-driven sequences, reactive dialogue, and radio-based NPC communication deliver a tight, cinematic experience that supports immersion without dragging control away from the player.

short_description: Primeval Genesis is a semi-linear & narrative driven third-person shooter where you are newly employed contractor. Outsmart deadly dinosaurs and hostile humans, solve environmental puzzles, and use tactical combat to survive in a tense, atmospheric tropical island.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Primeval Genesis contains frequent depictions of violence, including intense combat against humans and prehistoric creatures, blood effects, and death animations. The game also includes dark thematic elements such as corporate negligence, isolation, and survival in hostile environments.

While there is no sexual content, players should be aware of mature themes such as injury, death, psychological stress, and references to human experimentation. Some scenes may be intense or frightening.
